git commit -m "fix(orchestrator): call onError for non-Error rejections

Wrap any rejection that is not an Error instance in an Error before passing it to the onError hook, preserving the original value as the cause. This ensures onError fires reliably for all rejections, including those from providers or tools that reject with strings, plain objects, or other non-Error values. The original rejection still propagates to the caller unchanged.

Fixes #95"
